organ_systems.name: Cardiovascular & Systemic Vascular System
organ_systems.overview: Closed high-pressure/low-pressure double circulation driven by myocardial time-varying elastance E(t), four unidirectional cardiac valves, coronary microcirculation, and systemic arterial/venous trees.

organ_systems.name: Respiratory & Tracheobronchial System
organ_systems.overview: Conducting upper/lower airways (larynx, trachea, main bronchi, bronchioles) coupled to 300M viscoelastic alveolar gas-exchange units governing PAO2, PACO2, and acid-base balance.

organ_systems.name: Central & Spinal Nervous System
organ_systems.overview: Cortical, subcortical, brainstem, cerebellar (Allen Brain CCF), and spinal cord neural circuits coordinating sensorimotor integration, cognition, and autonomic cardiorespiratory tone.

organ_systems.name: Renal & Urinary Tract System
organ_systems.overview: Bilateral renal cortex/medulla nephron beds, calyces, renal pelvises, ureters, and bladder regulating glomerular filtration rate (GFR), extracellular volume, electrolytes, and RAAS.

organ_systems.name: Hepatobiliary & Metabolic Detoxification System
organ_systems.overview: Hepatic lobular sinusoids, portal triad, and biliary tree orchestrating gluconeogenesis, VLDL/ApoB lipoprotein assembly, acute-phase proteins, bile synthesis, and CYP450 xenobiotic clearance.

organ_systems.name: Gastrointestinal & Enteric Absorptive System
organ_systems.overview: Small intestine (duodenum, jejunum, ileum), large intestine (cecum, appendix, colon segments, rectum), and greater omentum driving enzymatic digestion, nutrient transport, incretin signaling, and mucosal barrier immunity.

organ_systems.name: Endocrine & Pancreatic Islet System
organ_systems.overview: Exocrine/endocrine pancreas (islets of Langerhans alpha/beta/delta cells) and metabolically active adipose depots regulating insulin-glucagon glucose homeostasis, incretin response, and adipokine signaling.

organ_systems.name: Hematopoietic & Lymphoid Immune System
organ_systems.overview: Primary (thymus, bone marrow) and secondary (spleen, lymph nodes, palatine tonsils) lymphoid organs governing T/B-cell repertoire selection, erythrocyte turnover, iron recycling, and cytokine surveillance.

organ_systems.name: Musculoskeletal System (Full Skeleton & Skeletal Musculature)
organ_systems.overview: Complete 216-bone axial & appendicular skeleton (cranium, mandible, C1-L5 vertebrae, 24 ribs, sternum, pectoral girdle, upper/lower limbs, hands, feet) co-registered with NIH HRA pelvis, C2-S1 intervertebral discs, synovial knee joints, and 177 striated skeletal muscles & tendons (BodyParts3D / DBCLS + NIH HRA).

organ_systems.name: Integumentary & Reproductive System
organ_systems.overview: Whole-body cutaneous barrier (epidermis, dermis, eccrine thermoregulation, cutaneous microvasculature) and reproductive tract structures.

By providing connections at the level of individual microfilaments, it contributes to the fine balance of forces between the two halves of the sarcomere. The size and extensibility of the cross-links are the main determinants of sarcomere extensibility properties of muscle. In non-muscle cells, seems to play a role in chromosome condensation and chromosome segregation during mitosis. Might link the lamina network to chromatin or nuclear actin, or both during interphase
